correctness.rationale: First-reset renewal gives survival Laplace transform [1−exp(−a sqrt((s+r)/D))]/[s+r exp(−b sqrt((s+r)/D))]. Differentiating at s=0 yields both passage-time moments and CV²−1=[e^(−t)/(1−e^(−t))](2−Hq(t)). Hq rises from 1 to infinity for 0<q≤1. For q≥1, differentiation gives (log Hq)″≤−1/t²+1/[4sinh²(t/2)]<0; for q>1 its unique maximum strictly decreases from >2 near q=1 to <2 by q=2. This proves precisely one, two, tangential one, or zero CV=1 crossings, with unique q_c≈1.228631400481950585 and t_c≈4.133452638304952835. Domain: fixed a,b,D,r>0 and absorbing Brownian halfline.
residual_risks: Numerical q_c,t_c are approximations to uniquely characterized real tangency.
Ensemble fixes initial position a, does not average over reset location.
